classification.difficultyReason: Several linked decisions using the demonstrated definitions or procedures. The integer domain and incompatible bounds combine the number-set, set-builder and empty-set definitions.

answer.short: No integer can be both greater than $8$ and less than $2$, so the set has no elements.
answer.worked: The conditions $x>8$ and $x<2$ must both hold. No real number, and therefore no integer, satisfies them simultaneously. Hence $\{x\in\mathbb{Z}\text{ where }8<x<2\}=\varnothing$.
